root_cause.text: fuse_dentry_init() failed to initialize dentry->d_time, causing fuse_dentry_revalidate() to read uninitialized memory from a newly allocated dentry, leading to undefined cache invalidation behavior and a KMSAN warning.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `dentry->d_time = 0;` in fuse_dentry_init() specifically to fix the uninit-value issue. The CVE description and KMSAN backtrace show the uninit-value originates in fuse_dentry_revalidate() at line 394, triggered when lookup_open() calls d_revalidate() on a dentry allocated via __d_alloc() without prior initialization of d_time. The commit message states “fuse_dentry_revalidate() may be called with a dentry that didn't had ->d_time initialised.”
